title: 第2章 老僧动春心
content_zh:
就在秦朗完全不能接受这突如其来的身份转变，而怔怔然时，十来辆增援的警车和几辆电视台以及新闻媒体的采访车驶进了现场，救护车也紧随其后赶到，为受伤的学生进行救治。

增援的警力荷枪实弹的拉开了警戒线。

从采访车上跳下的各路记者也扛起长枪短炮做起了报道，不时的对周围围观的学生进行一些采访。

现场的气氛变得更加热烈起来，那些一直生活在象牙塔里的学生们，难得经历这样的突发事件，对于眼前发生的一切都充满了新奇，或窃窃私语，或大声喧哗，完全没有半点替秦朗紧张的念头。

“请问这位同学，你对学校发生这样的恶性案件有什么样的看法？”人群西侧，一名男记者正对着一名女生采访。

周围的男生，不时的拿眼偷瞟着这名女生，滚动喉结，咽着口水。

也难怪这些男生一副猪哥相，女生叫戚玲珑，是平安一中的校花。能在这么多学生中脱颖而出成为校花，相貌上自然是极美。再加上那甜美中透着一丝丝高傲的气质，假以时日绝对是个祸国殃民的大美人儿。

“不好意思，我没有什么看法。”戚玲珑淡淡的拒绝了记者的采访。

男记者不肯放弃，继续追问了一番，但得到的还是冷漠寡淡的回应。碰了一鼻子灰的男记者，心有不甘的掏出了一张卡片，“这是我的名片，我在电视台工作，最近我们电视台做一档节目需要一个学生年龄的外景主持人，我觉得同学你的形象气质都很符合，如果你有意的话，咱们可以私下联系一下。”

“拜托，你这样的搭讪方式也太老土了吧，咱们家玲珑才看不上眼呢。”戚玲珑还没说话，挽着她胳膊的闺蜜高丽就替她拒绝了。

男记者怏怏的离开以后，高丽叹了一口气羡慕的说道：“唉，校花就是校花，你看看，刚刚那记者光顾着跟你搭话，连看都不看我一眼。我要是有玲珑你一半漂亮就好了。”

“我倒是希望自己能普通一些，省的天天被这些苍蝇骚扰。”戚玲珑撇撇嘴道。

高丽心里油然生出几分嫉妒，作为校花的闺蜜，固然有许多便利，但是绿叶做的久了，心里也就难免失衡了。

“玲珑，你说那秦朗会不会真被那疯子给杀掉？”高丽换了个话题问道。

“不知道。”戚玲珑漠然的摇摇头。

“我猜，你一定是求之不得。嘿嘿，他可是你名义上的未婚夫，偏偏你又那么不待见他，如果真的就这样死在那疯子的手上，岂不是以后你都省心了。”作为闺蜜，高丽知道戚玲珑那只有极少数人清楚的婚约。

戚玲珑眉头一皱，却什么话都没说。

高丽还想深挖这个话题，满足自己熊熊燃烧的八卦之心，但被一个歇斯底里的声音给打断了。

“妈的，来这么多人以为老子就会怕么？告诉你们，老子天不怕地不怕。”

声音的来源正是被人群团团包围的赵铁柱。

随着警力的增加，以及媒体记者的到访，赵铁柱的情绪愈发焦躁不安。

他疯狂的挥舞着菜刀，手臂也发疯似的狠勒着秦朗的脖子，像是要把怨气撒到秦朗头上似的。

沉浸在身份转变的巨大震惊中的秦朗，被这股窒息感憋得回过神来。

“夺舍，竟然是夺舍，这种事情怎么会发生在我的身上？”

回过神来的秦朗，一肚子的不可思议，脑子里无比的凌乱。接受了这具身体原主人的记忆信息以后，他终于意识到自己身上发生的情况，就是夺舍。

夺舍这种事情他早有耳闻，那是修士在万不得已的情况下，一种借尸还魂延续性命的方法，但一万个人里面，也不见得能有一个人能成功夺舍。

他怎么也想不明白，自己根本没有做过任何夺舍的举动，为什么会有夺舍的现象发生，并且他还夺舍成功了。

不仅如此，他还跨越了两个世界，从原本的丹鼎大陆，夺舍到了这个叫做地球的世界上来，这让他有种天方夜谭，如同做梦的感觉。

可惜，这时候已经容不得他去深思了，胸腔传来的窒息感，让他察觉到了强烈的危机。

“不行，这样下去的话，恐怕我要被活活的勒死。其他的问题可以先放一放，暂时先摆脱眼前的危机再说。”

认清楚了形势，秦朗本能的想要自救。

但是他马上就发现，事情没有那么容易。

尽管他还来不及去细查这具新身体的状况，但是他能清晰的感觉这具身体非常的弱小，甚至放在普通人里，都属于特别虚弱的那一种。

凭借这样一具身体，他根本没有能力去摆脱身后那个赵铁柱的控制。

“没有法宝，也没有修为，甚至浑身上下根本就没几分力气，这可怎么办才好？”

忍耐着越来越强烈的窒息感，秦朗绞尽脑汁的思索起来。

只见他隐藏在衣服下的肚子，突然开始有规律的一鼓一缩起来，乍一看极像是一个立着的蛤蟆。

这是丹鼎大陆上一种极其普通的呼吸方法，叫做“换元呼吸法”。它不需要任何修为基础，哪怕是普通人都可以运用。只是，它需要消耗人体极少量的生命元气，但基本不会产生什么危害。

而它的好处就是可以在呼吸不畅的时候，避免被窒息的命运，这一点恰好满足秦朗此刻的要求。

更重要的是，换元呼吸法还可以蓄积体力，爆发潜能。

虽然秦朗现在身体很孱弱，没有多少力气，但如果将力量蓄积并且集中起来，在最关键的时候，抓住时机爆发，他还是有信心凭借近身打斗的技巧，拿下身后这个凶徒。

随着换元呼吸法运转开来，秦朗呼吸不畅的情况大为缓解，燃烧生命元气转化来的气力和潜能也在悄然聚集。

解决了燃眉之急，秦朗依然没有掉以轻心，因为赵铁柱手里的刀，依然对他时刻产生着威胁。

他一边警惕着赵铁柱的举动，一边留意着警察那边的变化，对于现在的他来说，警察的存在是帮助他化解危机的一个重要帮助。

就在秦朗暗中观察的时候，警方那边最早跟赵铁柱交流的那名中年警察，重新站了出来，隔着警戒线，朝赵铁柱喊话道：“铁柱兄弟，请你不要激动，只要你肯放了手上那名学生，有什么条件，咱们都可以谈。”

“老子跟你们这些警察没什么好谈的。”赵铁柱一口回绝了对方谈话的意图，“想让老子放人，就让梅语嫣那个贱人出来见我。”

梅语嫣这个名字，平安一中的师生并不陌生。她是这所学校的美术老师，因为其美貌和温婉的气质让全校不少男老师和男生视为心中女神。身边总不乏各路追求者，却从没见过她跟哪个异性有过亲密接触。

如今听到这个疯子劫匪口中冒出梅语嫣的名字，还加上“贱人”这样的称呼，围观的师生们顿时惊讶的议论起来。

有消息灵通者卖弄道：“我听说，早上这疯子在办公室跟梅老师还有钱大兵发生争吵，好像是感情问题，后来这疯子被钱大兵揍了一顿赶了出去。再后来，这疯子就拎着把刀，冲进办公室，没找到梅语嫣和钱大兵之后，就追着路过的学生乱砍。”

不知情的围观者一听，这才知道了事情的缘由。

对于梅语嫣和这个疯子之间的感情纠纷，大家既惊讶又好奇。

因为无论怎么看，梅老师这样的女神，和赵铁柱这个连**丝都谈不上的土鳖都产生不了任何联系。

既然连**丝都谈不上，自然不存在什么**丝逆袭女神这样的事情。

“梅老师不会这么重口味吧，放着大把的青年才俊不要，非得跟这个不知道从哪个山旮旯里跑出来的疯子产生感情纠葛，我感觉自己不会再爱了。”有男生心碎的说道。

在所有人都被这耸人听闻的消息而震撼的时候，一名警员拿着手机，匆匆走到举着喇叭的中年警察面前说道：“高队长，已经联系上赵铁柱的家人了。”

被称作高队长的中年警察年色一喜，确认电话另一头是赵铁柱的父亲以后，便用音频线直接将手机和喇叭对接，手机里的声音立刻通过扩音喇叭传递出来。

“铁柱，我是你爹。”一个中气十足，带着地方腔调的苍老声音从喇叭里清晰的扩散开来。

听到自家老爹的声音，一直处于癫狂状态的赵铁柱顿时一怔，整个人静了下来。

“警察说你跑到小梅的学校去了，还拿刀砍伤了人。小梅这个骚蹄子不是什么好东西，当年若不是我家拿钱支持她上学，她连饭都吃不饱。现在活成城里人了，就不把咱们这些恩人放在眼里了，也翻脸不认当年和铁柱你定亲的事情了。爹跟你说，你千万别怕，不就是砍伤几个人么，咱们就是要让那骚蹄子看看，咱们可不是好欺负的。”

随着苍老的声音徐徐说完，现场陡然诡异的一静，旋即哄笑成一团。

不过这话里透露的讯息，也让不少学生议论纷纷。他们不敢想象，女神一样的梅老师会有这么俗套的往事，并且还是个过河拆桥的人。

“果然不是一家人不进一家门，有其子必有其父啊。”高队长气急败坏的关掉了喇叭，他本来是希望通过赵铁柱的家人，达到劝服对方的目的，岂料，这赵铁柱他爹更不是个东西，竟然肆无忌惮的怂恿儿子犯罪。

赵铁柱也大笑起来，受到他爹的鼓励，他似乎充满了力量，更加张扬自己暴虐的情绪。

约莫又过去十分钟的时间，围观的人群中，突然有学生喊道：“快看，梅老师来了。”

立刻，所有人的目光都朝着一个正走过来的身影上移去。

秦朗也同样将目光移到了这个身影上，这是一个二十来岁的年轻女性，虽然只穿着简单的毛呢大衣，但却掩盖不了那俏美的容颜，和婀娜的身段。即便秦朗阅人无数，也不得不承认，这是一个不折不扣的美女。

但不知道为什么，在看清楚身影的主人以后，他的心跳突然加速，内心没来由的升起一种既甜蜜又羞涩的感觉。

这种突如其来的心理变化，吓了秦朗一跳。

“我怎么会有这样的感觉？难道是此人有古怪？”

迷惑不解的秦朗，立刻对来人警惕起来。

他一边进一步的观察对方，一边翻动记忆试图寻找答案，很快的，他就从记忆里找到了自己心理变化的根源。

原来这具身体的原主人，对这位美女老师一直暗藏爱慕之意，从见到这位梅老师第一眼起，就迷上了对方，甚至梦遗的时候，都是以对方为对象。

得到这样的答案，秦朗真有些哭笑不得。要知道，在以往数百年的修行生涯中，他一直刻苦修炼，钻研丹道，对于女色他向来不感兴趣，犹如老僧入定，内心不为任何女色产生涟漪。

哪曾想，现如今却仅仅只是看到一个女人的身影，就轻易的使得内心产生这样复杂的波动。

“看来夺舍的后遗症比我想象的还要严重，我虽然融合了这具身体的记忆，但也受到了强烈的影响，恐怕连我的性情都会因此受到改变，也不知道这是好事，还是坏事。”

秦朗暗暗叹了一口气，心里头不是个滋味。

《修仙高手在校园》最新章节由云起书院首发，最新最火最快网络小说首发地！（本站提供：传统翻页、瀑布阅读两种模式，可在设置中选择）
content_en:
Just when Qin Lang could not accept this sudden change of identity, he was stunned. More than a dozen reinforced police cars and several television stations and interview vehicles from the news media drove into the scene, and the ambulance followed closely behind to rescue the injured students.

增援的警力荷枪实弹的拉开了警戒线。

Various reporters who jumped from the interview car also carried long guns and short cannons to start reporting, and from time to time they interviewed the students around them.

The atmosphere at the scene became more enthusiastic. Those students who had been living in the ivory tower rarely experienced such emergencies. Everything in front of them was full of novelty, or whispers, or loud noises. There was no thought of nervousness for Qin Lang at all.

"Excuse me, this classmate, what is your opinion on the occurrence of such a vicious case at the school?" On the west side of the crowd, a male reporter was interviewing a female student.

The boys around him, from time to time, took their eyes and glanced at the girl, rolling their throat knots and swallowing saliva.

No wonder these boys were a pair of pig brothers. The girl's name was Qi Linglong, and it was the school flower of Ping 'an No. 1 Middle School. Being able to stand out among so many students as a school flower is naturally beautiful in appearance. Coupled with a hint of arrogance in the sweetness, she was definitely a great beauty of the scourge of the country and the people in time.

"I'm sorry, I have no opinion. Qi Linglong faintly refused the reporter's interview.

The male reporter refused to give up and continued to ask, but received an indifferent response. A male reporter touched his nose and unwillingly pulled out a card. "This is my business card. I work at a TV station. Recently, we have a TV station that needs a student-age outlook host. I think your image and temperament are very consistent with the classmates. If you want, we can contact you privately."

"Please, your way of accosting is too old-fashioned. Our family is exquisite. Before Qi Linglong could speak, his girlfriend Gory, who was holding her arm, refused for her.

After the male reporter left, Gaoli sighed enviously and said: "Alas, the school flower is the school flower. Look at it. The reporter just patronized and talked to you, and didn't even look at me. If only I could make you half as beautiful as Linglong."

"I wish I could be more ordinary. The provinces are harassed by these flies every day. Qi Linglong curled his lips.

Goryeo naturally developed a bit of jealousy in her heart. As a girlfriend of the school flower, there are many conveniences, but after the green leaves have been made for a long time, it is inevitable that her heart will be out of balance.

"Linglong, do you think that Qin Lang will really be killed by that lunatic? Goryeo changed the subject and asked.

“不知道。”戚玲珑漠然的摇摇头。

"I guess you must be begging for it. Hehe, he's your nominal fiancé, but you don't treat him like that. If you really die at the hands of that lunatic, you won't have to worry about it in the future." As a girlfriend, Goryeo knew that only a very few people knew about Qi Linglong's engagement.

戚玲珑眉头一皱，却什么话都没说。

Goliath also wanted to dig deeper into the topic to satisfy her burning gossip, but was interrupted by a hysterical voice.

"Damn it, do you think Lao Tzu will be scared if so many people come? I tell you, Lao Zi is not afraid."

声音的来源正是被人群团团包围的赵铁柱。

With the increase in the police force and the visit of media reporters, Zhao Tiezhu's emotions became more and more restless.

He was frantically waving a kitchen knife, and his arms were strangling Qin Lang's neck like crazy, as if to sprinkle resentment on Qin Lang's head.

Qin Lang, immersed in the huge shock of identity transformation, was suffocated by this feeling of suffocation.

"Seizing the property is actually seizing the property. How could such a thing happen to me?"

When Qin Lang returned to his senses, his stomach was incredible and his mind was extremely messy. After accepting the memory information of the original owner of this body, he finally realized that what was happening to him was to seize the sacrifice.

He had heard about this kind of thing before. It was a way for monks to continue their lives by borrowing corpses and returning souls as a last resort. However, among 10,000 people, it was unlikely that one person could succeed in seizing the property.

How could he not understand that he had not made any moves to seize the house at all. Why did the phenomenon of seizing the house occur, and he also succeeded in seizing the house.

Not only that, he also crossed two worlds, from the original Danding Continent, to this world called Earth, which gave him a sense of fantasy, like a dream.

Unfortunately, at this time, he could no longer afford to think deeply. The feeling of suffocation in his chest made him aware of a strong crisis.

"I can't. If I continue like this, I'm afraid I'll be strangled alive. Other issues can be put aside for a while to get rid of the immediate crisis."

认清楚了形势，秦朗本能的想要自救。

但是他马上就发现，事情没有那么容易。

Although he had not yet had time to examine the condition of this new body, he could clearly feel that this body was very weak, and even in ordinary people, it belonged to the particularly weak type.

With such a body, he had no ability to get rid of the one behind him, Zhao Tiezhu.

"There is no magic weapon, no cultivation, and there is not even a little strength on the whole body. What should I do?"

Enduring the increasingly strong feeling of suffocation, Qin Lang racked his brain and thought.

Seeing his stomach hidden under his clothes, he suddenly began to regularly shrink drums. At first glance, he looked like a standing toad.

This is an extremely common breathing method on the mainland of Danding, called "elemental exchange breathing method". It does not need any repair basis, even ordinary people can use it. However, it needs to consume a very small amount of vitality from the human body, but it will not cause any harm at all.

The advantage of it is that it can avoid the fate of suffocation when breathing is not smooth, which just meets the requirements of Qin Lang at this moment.

More importantly, the elemental exchange breathing method can also accumulate physical strength and burst potential.

Although Qin Lang is very weak now, he does not have much strength, but if he accumulates and concentrates his strength, at the most critical time, seizing the opportunity to explode, he still has the confidence to take down the murderer behind him with the skill of close combat.

With the operation of the breathing method, Qin Lang's difficulty in breathing was greatly alleviated, and the energy and potential transformed by the burning of the life essence were quietly gathered.

After solving the urgent problem, Qin Lang still did not take it lightly, because the knife in Zhao Tiezhu's hand still threatened him at all times.

He was vigilant about Zhao Tiezhu's actions, while paying attention to the changes on the police's side. For him now, the existence of the police was an important help to help him defuse the crisis.

While Qin Lang was secretly observing, the middle-aged policeman on the police side who first communicated with Zhao Tiezhu stood up again and shouted to Zhao Tiezhu across the cordon: "Brother Tiezhu, please don't get excited. As long as you are willing to let go of the student in your hand, we can talk about anything."

"I have nothing to talk about with you policemen. Zhao Tiezhu rejected the other party's intention to talk." If you want Lao Zi to let people go, let Mei Yanyan come out to see me. "

Mei Yanyan's name was no stranger to teachers and students in Ping 'an Yizhong. She is the art teacher of this school, because of her beauty and gentle temperament, many male teachers and boys in the school are regarded as the goddess of the heart. There were always suitors around, but she had never seen any intimate contact with the opposite sex.

Now that she heard the name of Mei Yan coming out of the mouth of this lunatic robber, and the name "bitch" was added, the teachers and students who were on the sidelines suddenly began to talk in surprise.

A well-informed person said, "I heard that this lunatic had a quarrel with Teacher Mei and the money soldier in the office in the morning, which seemed to be an emotional problem. Later, this lunatic was beaten up and kicked out by the money soldier. Later, the lunatic carried a knife and rushed into the office. After failing to find Mei Yanyan and Qian Dabing, he chased after the passing students."

Unknowing onlookers listened, and only then did they learn the reason for the incident.

Everyone was both surprised and curious about the emotional dispute between Mei Yanyan and this lunatic.

Because no matter how you look at it, a goddess like Teacher Mei, and Zhao Tiezhu, who can't even talk about silk, can't make any contact.

Since you can't even talk about * * silk, naturally there is no such thing as * * silk attacking the goddess.

"Teacher Mei will not have such a heavy taste. Don't put a lot of young talents in it. I have to have an emotional entanglement with this lunatic who doesn't know which mountain to run from. I feel that I will not love again." A boy said with a broken heart.

While everyone was shocked by this sensational news, a policeman with a mobile phone hurried to the middle-aged policeman holding a horn and said, "Captain Gao, we have contacted Zhao Tiezhu's family."

The middle-aged policeman known as Captain Gao was delighted. After confirming that the other end of the phone was Zhao Tiezhu's father, he docked the phone and the speaker directly with the audio cable. The voice in the phone was immediately transmitted through the loudspeaker.

"Tiezhu, I'm your father. A calm, old voice with a local tone clearly diffused from the horn.
